rows.name: SpatialMap_InsertRectangle
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 rectangle (y0,x0,y1,x1), stack8 object; RET8. Clips to +54..60 and prepends kind-1 records row-major via 6f14d2e0. Only caller: SpatialObject_Load 6f14d000.

rows.name: SpatialObject_Load
rows.comment:
[MAP-06.2] Spatial object vtable slot (6fa9096c+4). Thiscall ECX object, stack4 stream; RET4. Reads map, payload handles, +34, rectangle +1C..28, +38 stamp, +3C refs, +40 flags; if not 0x10000000 re-inserts the saved rectangle via 6f14d380.
Payoff135 Save120: retain logical proximity object stamps, insert rectangles in save order; load registers a fresh maintenance request. Link table/free-list identities are reconstructed, not persisted process pointers.

rows.name: SpatialObject_Save
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Spatial object vtable slot 6fa9096c. Thiscall ECX object, stack4 stream; RET4. Writes map/payload handles, +34, rectangle, +38, +3C, +40.

rows.name: SpatialMap_Save
rows.comment:
[MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream; RET4. Geometry 6f14d590, stamp +B4, PathRandom +BC/+C0, then per cell (row-major) 6f14d4c0: cells with nonzero high byte or flagged (0x10000000) live objects only.
Payoff135 Save120: after full proximity compaction, map stamp and logical owner rectangles/stamps are written; no heap/process pointer. Generic region collectors and fine map save stamps remain separate open work.
Payoff136 Save121: full fine compaction then fine32-bit map stamp,16-bit request generation stored as validated u32, logical ordinary owner rectangle/stamp. Proximity stamp payload follows separately. No retained raw slot identity/process pointer is serialized.

rows.name: SpatialMap_SaveCell
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream, stack8 x, stackC y, stack10 collector; RET10, EAX 1 written / 0 skipped. Collector 6f14cdf0 (flagged objects only, chain order) then x, y, high byte, count, handles.

rows.name: SpatialMap_LoadSaved
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream; RET4. Geometry 6f14d140, stamp +B4, PathRandom +BC/+C0, cells refilled 0xffffff, dirty zeroed, saved cells via 6f14d0b0, new maintenance request (same arithmetic as 6f14c990).

rows.name: SpatialMap_LoadCell
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream; RET4. Reads x, y, high byte, count; sets cell high byte; prepends each saved handle as kind 1 (6f14d2e0) in saved order, so the saved chain order is reversed.

rows.name: SpatialMap_SaveGeometry
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream; RET4. Width, height, +44..+50 floats, bounds +54..+60, scale +64/+68.

rows.name: SpatialMap_LoadGeometry
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 stream; RET4. Inverse of 6f14d590.

rows.name: PathMaps_Save
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX owner, stack4 stream; RET4. Writes 6 map handles, full compaction 6f14dfc0 of +234 then +238, 6f14d620 for both, adaptive 6f163120, then search-system handles.

rows.name: PathMaps_LoadSaved
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX owner, stack4 stream; RET4. Reads 6 map handles, 6f14d1d0 for +234/+238, 6f162f20 adaptive, then +24C/+250 handles.

rows.name: PathOwner_Save
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX owner, stack4 stream; RET4. Section-framed: PathMaps_Save 6f15c750 first, then 6f167500, 6f15c8b0 x2, 6f15c930. Caller 6f04dd30.

rows.name: PathOwner_LoadSaved
rows.comment: [MAP-06.2] Thiscall ECX owner, stack4 stream. Calls PathMaps_LoadSaved 6f15c180. Caller 6f04ced0.

rows.name: SpatialMap_PrependInsertion
rows.comment: [SEP-03.1] Thiscall ECX map, stack4 cell word pointer, stack8 object; RET8. Prepends a kind-1 record (free list or 6f14dde0 append); +B0++ only (object +3C untouched, no dirty bit). Callers: save-load 6f14d0b0 and 6f14d380.
